template.title: Thursday Karaoke at WesCo Brew & Bowl
template.shortDescription: Thursday karaoke at WesCo Brew & Bowl, 7:00–10:00 PM Eastern.
template.description: Come sing with Four Dogs at WesCo Brew & Bowl on Thursdays from 7:00 to 10:00 PM Eastern. Pick your favorite song, grab the mic, and bring your friends. Check the calendar for confirmed dates and holiday exceptions.
template.instructions: Karaoke runs from 7:00 to 10:00 PM Eastern. Contact WesCo for seating and participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.

changes.title: 90s vs. 2000s: The Ultimate Throwback Music Bingo
changes.theme: 90s vs. 2000s: The Ultimate Throwback Music Bingo
changes.shortDescription: The 90s and 2000s go head-to-head. Recognize your favorites and see which decade rules your bingo card.
changes.description: CDs or MP3s? We're bringing the biggest throwback favorites from the 90s and 2000s to WesCo. We play song clips. If you hear a song on your card, mark it and play for bingo.
changes.instructions: We play song clips. If you hear a song on your card, mark it and play for bingo. Pick up a card at WesCo, then listen and mark your matches. Start time to be announced. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
